en:
<CLT=cltMIND>If I remember correctly, the gold leaf
katana is from...

First, we should confirm whether the katana
used in the murder really came from here.

Still...there's tons of weird-looking stuff
in this place.

I thought it was all a bunch of useless junk
at first, but I guess it's not...
...Sorry, don't mind me.

First, we should confirm whether the katana
used in the murder really came from here.
You can deal with the seance.

I'll head back to the crime scene to
re-examine the clues.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to find out more about
that katana...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to find out more about
that katana...

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to find out more about
that katana...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's just the sheath!

<CLT=cltMIND>Earlier, the katana was inside
the sheath...

Maki, the gold leaf katana definitely came
from here. I'm certain of it.

Doesn't that make Kiyo suspicious?
This is his research lab, after all.

Not necessarily. Anyone could have
come in here and taken it.

...Fair enough. Anyone could have done the
same with my lab, too.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Gold Leaf Katana<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been updated in the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
Oh? What are you guys doing here?

...What are *you* doing here? Shouldn't you
be helping with the seance?

Nee-heehee... You look so disgusted right now.
Then again, I guess that is your signature look.

Anyway, I forgot to bring something we need
for the seance, so I came back to get it.
Something for the seance?
Yep, that white sheet over there.

We brought the wooden dog statue and the cage
already, but I guess we need that sheet too.

I don't get it... Why do you guys need a cage,
a wooden dog statue, and a white sheet?

Hey, don't ask me! I don't know why
we need that stuff, either!

That's why I figured I'd do a little research
on this seance before I got the sheet.
...Study?
Soooo, let's see...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi took a look around and...
I heard it was, like, some old handmade book...
Oh, is this it!?

Yep, it says <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltNORMAL> right here
on the cover, so this must be it.

Let's see... What does it say about <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged
Child<CLT=cltNORMAL> seance...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi flipped through the old book
he picked up.

Oh, is it this page? It's hard to read, but I
can see <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL> is mentioned here.

Yeah, Kiyo's drawing the same magic circle
as the one in this picture...

Okay, let's see...
In order to perform <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...you need five people, including the spirit
medium, and a dark place with no light.
Just like Kiyo said...

First, draw the magic circle, passed down from
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltNORMAL>, on the ground...

In the center of the circle, the spirit medium
must kneel, curl like a turtle...

...and rest their forehead on a stone on the
ground. Afterward, the other four participants...

...must put the iron cage over the spirit
medium, and cover it with a white sheet...

And finally, the Dog God must be placed 
on top of the cage.

Also, it says we can't step on the
magic circle during the preparations...

The "Dog God"? Do you mean the
wooden dog statue?

When preparations are complete, turn out all
the lights to create complete darkness...

The seance will begin when the four participants
are each standing at a corner of the room.

The four participants, not including the spirit
medium, will sing <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL> song...

After the song, ask, "Is <CLT=cltSTRONG>the caged child<CLT=cltNORMAL>..." 
then say the name of the spirit.

The spirit medium will reply in the voice of
the summoned spirit...and that's all it says!
That sounds...complicated.

Complicated plans have a better chance of
working out in the end, wouldn't you say?

Whether it works or not...Kiyo has been wanting
to conduct this seance for a while.

Since I was fortunate enough to obtain one of
those copies, I have already memorized it.

Kehehe... But I never thought I'd be able to lay
eyes on the real one... What a trick of fate.

Oh, yeah. He said he memorized every
word of it, too.

That's probably why he left the book here, cuz
he can conduct the seance without it.

But is it even possible?
Contacting Angie's ghost...?

Nee-heehee... If you're so curious, why
don't you join us, Shuichi?
Huh?

You should see how it plays out with your
own eyes.

There's still time, y'know. The seance hasn't
even started yet.
Maybe it's better if you join them.
You think so...?
Well, I'm not going. I don't believe in seances.

But whether you believe or not, as a detective
you should be there to observe what happens.
<CLT=cltMIND>As a detective, huh...
Yeah...I think you're right.
Nee-heehee... Now you're talking.

Well, I'll be waiting for you! Of the three
empty rooms, we're in the middle one.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi spoke as though he was inviting
me to go play, then left the room.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>The katana should be here, but all
that's left is the sheath.

<CLT=cltMIND>The murder weapon was brought
from this room, I'm certain of it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I believe the katana was on
display, right here in this case...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's packed with books and scrolls...
They're all weathered and old.
<CLT=cltMIND>No time to read now, though.
<CLT=cltMIND>This cloth...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I see. It's the white fabric that
covers the cage in <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose they already took the
cage to the room...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is most likely the white frabric that
covers the cage in <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose they already took the
cage to the room...

<CLT=cltMIND><CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltMIND> book
is still here...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo said that he has read it so many
times, he can recite it by memory.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose he doesn't need it
to perform the seance.
